description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named ActivityTransition, which manages shared element transitions between activities. It handles UI setup, transition callbacks, and interaction logic involving images and transitions.

classes.name: ActivityTransition
classes.description: An Android activity that demonstrates shared element transitions. It manages image views, transition names, and navigation to detailed views with animated transitions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and configures the transition setup.

methods.name: setupHero
methods.description: Sets up the shared element (hero) view and its callback for transition mapping.

methods.name: clicked
methods.description: Handles click events on views, starting a new activity with a shared element transition.
